debug_method: exact-run dynamic replay; generated project remained read-only to the main Agent
symptom: Physical Go tests and entrypoint passed, but ProjectOutcome and the append-only convergence cursor repeatedly remained control_plane_blocked.

root_causes.cause: A successful tested Go package followed by a helper package with [no test files] was treated as missing test proof.
root_causes.fix: Accept proof when at least one exact ok <package> line exists; preserve failure authority for non-zero verifier receipts.

root_causes.cause: Changing builtin proof semantics did not change verifier policy identity, allowing stale policy decisions to survive.
root_causes.fix: Bind BUILTIN_PROOF_SEMANTICS_VERSION into the verifier-policy decision payload.

root_causes.cause: Project-completion diagnostics treated any non-zero exit code as failure, overriding the entrypoint receipt's authoritative readiness plus controlled-termination success semantics.
root_causes.fix: For entrypoint evidence, retain the typed receipt status; apply generic non-zero-exit rejection only to non-entrypoint verifiers.

root_causes.cause: Stronger replacement receipts changed a still-completed owner binding hash. The convergence cursor first rejected the new hash, then a legal owner_binding_revalidated terminal refresh was rejected as an event after terminal.
root_causes.fix: Re-query current owner authority; append a replacement completed terminal only when the owner is still completed; parse only consecutive, same-identity completed_verified refreshes explicitly marked owner_binding_revalidated. All other post-terminal events remain fail-closed.

regression_followup.symptom: The full Factory admission suite exposed a cancel/complete lifecycle race that timed out while publishing a false project-completion blocker.
regression_followup.dynamic_root_cause: Direct lifecycle completion without a persisted successful quality_gate StageResult incorrectly invoked post-terminal ProjectOutcome notification.
regression_followup.fix: Notify post-terminal convergence only when the completed run carries a persisted successful quality_gate result; direct lifecycle completion remains local and does not manufacture QA authority.
regression_followup.proof: The exact failing concurrency test and the successful-QA ordering test both passed; the full admission file then passed 70/70.

recovery_scope: same Factory run; qa_gate only; PM, Chief Engineer, and Director were not restarted
residual_risk: Factory project_completion_advance uses terminal=false as a non-terminal Factory event-envelope flag even when its typed status is completed_verified; consumers must use typed status/reason codes, not the envelope flag, for ProjectOutcome authority.
